allow: PowerShell($icons = @\('cog','wheat','truck','code','graduation-cap','shield','handshake','wrench','git-merge','zap','activity','arrow-right','arrow-left','arrow-up-right','corner-down-right','layers','message-square','plug','shopping-cart','radio','cpu','book-open','check','trending-up','scan-eye','file-text','shield-check','workflow'\); $json = Get-Content node_modules/@iconify-json/lucide/icons.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach \($i in $icons\) { if \(-not $json.icons.PSObject.Properties.Name.Contains\($i\)\) { "MISSING: $i" } }; "checked $\($icons.Count\) icons")

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\('/','/tech/axioms','/privacy','/terms','/contact'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:3123$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 25; "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\) | $\([math]::Round\($r.RawContentLength/1kb,1\)\)kb" } catch { "$p -> FAILED: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
